blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On assuming leadership of the Bureau of Customs (BOC) following his oath-taking on Nov. 13, Charlito Martin R. Mendoza vowed to pursue government efforts to strengthen border security, improve revenue collection, combat smuggling, and facilitate legitimate trade. Mendoza returns to the BOC with extensive experience in revenue administration, institutional reform, and public service, having previously served as Commissioner of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), Undersecretary of Finance, and District Collector of the BOC Port of Cebu.
